subtopics.title: Overview of HTTP
subtopics.summary: Web page structure (HTML base file plus referenced objects), URLs, browsers and Web servers as HTTP client/server, and HTTP's stateless request-response model.

subtopics.title: Non-Persistent vs. Persistent Connections
subtopics.summary: How HTTP uses TCP connections: non-persistent connections with one object per connection, persistent connections with multiple objects, and response-time analysis using round-trip time.

subtopics.title: HTTP Message Format
subtopics.summary: Structure of HTTP request messages (request line, header lines, methods like GET and POST) and response messages (status line, status codes, headers, entity body).

subtopics.title: User-Server Interaction: Cookies
subtopics.summary: The four cookie components (cookie file, header lines, backend database) and how cookies enable stateful user identification over a stateless protocol.

subtopics.title: Web Caching
subtopics.summary: Proxy servers as caches, cache hits and misses, benefits of caching (reduced response time and traffic), and the conditional GET for keeping cached copies fresh.

subtopics.title: HTTP/2
subtopics.summary: HTTP/2's framing mechanism, multiplexing of requests/responses over one TCP connection, and how it addresses head-of-line blocking and improves page-load latency.
